title: A failed chat-list read is not retried until reload
evidence: When listConversations returns null, listLanded still moves the list to read and keeps the old list (packages/health-core/src/chat-turn.ts:244), so the next list-wanted is a no-op and the chat list stays as it was until the page reloads. Main's hasLoadedRef behaved the same way. The owner ruled it out of chat-turn slice 3 (2026-11-12).
